description: Tracked keywords whose latest ranking URL is not the target URL you declared for them (see set_rank_keyword_target_url). FREE: database only, no SEO data provider is called and no credits are spent. NOT the same detector as get_cannibalisation_report (Search Console-based), which finds two-or-more of the site's OWN pages splitting Search Console impressions for one query. A rank check records only the single best-ranking URL per keyword per run, so this can only tell you the winning page was not the one you intended — not that a second own page also appeared in the SERP.

configId.description: Rank tracker config ID. Call get_rank_tracker without a trackerId to list the project's trackers and their IDs.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: list_rank_cannibalisation
